name: YMS's Furniture
description: Lamps, chairs and bookshelves at small margins. Opening asks are at most 30 % over our floor (2 % while the shop is quiet), any offer at or above the floor is accepted from your second offer, and every receipt is signed with the shop's Ed25519 key. A model writes every ask; the code keeps the floor and answers if the model is slow.
